Gen AI - LeadJob Description

We are seeking a Frontend GenAI Engineer to build modern, secure, and user-centric web applications for Risk solutions. This role blends high-quality React-based frontend engineering with GenAI/agentic workflow development using LangChain and LangGraph.

Required Technical Skills :

Frontend

Strong expertise in React (modern hooks, component architecture, state management patterns)

Programming

Proficiency in Python for building GenAI services, orchestration layers, and integrations
Ability to write clean, maintainable, testable code; strong debugging and problem-solving skills

GenAI / Agentic Frameworks

Demonstrated working knowledge of LangChain and LangGraph
Experience designing agent workflows: tool calling, structured outputs, prompt engineering, routing, fallback strategies
Familiarity with RAG patterns and common failure modes (hallucinations, retrieval drift, injection)

Cloud

Cloud-agnostic mindset: ability to design solutions deployable across major cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP) or on-prem containers

Datastores

Working knowledge of any database (SQL/NoSQL) and any vector DB (e.g., Pinecone/Weaviate/FAISS/pgvector/Elastic vector search)

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with API design and integration patterns (REST/GraphQL), and backend collaboration
Awareness of Responsible AI practices and governance considerations (auditability, traceability, model risk)
Experience in Risk, Compliance and Audit domain (preferred but not required)

Required Experience

Must be proficient in ReactJS, Python, Langchain
Must have at least 1 production grade GenAI application with these technologies
Excellent communication skills to partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Mandatory Competencies
Data AI - GEN AI - Workflow Agentic Frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph)
Data AI - GEN AI - AI Search Index
Data AI - GEN AI - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) / Graph RAG / Agentic AI Systems
Data AI - GEN AI - Advanced GenAI Agentic Framework Concepts
Data AI - GEN AI - Fine-tuning Model Customization / AI Agents Tool Calling
Data AI - GEN AI - Cloud Application Integration Deployment
Data AI - GEN AI - Python
Data AI - GEN AI - Prompt Engineering / Vector Databases
Data AI - GEN AI - Pandas
Data AI - GEN AI - NumPy
Beh - Communication and collaboration
